content:
Solutions Engineering + Pro Services Weekly Sync - Tue 2026-06-09
Time: 10:00 - 10:45 PT
Location: #solutions-pro-services Zoom / Slack thread: #sps-weekly
Note taker: Alex Chen

Attendees:
- Alex Chen (owner)
- Priya Patel (lead SE)
- Miguel Santos (pro services PM)
- Dana Rivers (SRE)
- Samir Gupta (customer success)
- Guests: Anna Li (Customer A technical lead), Rob Carter (Customer B integration lead)

Agenda:
1) Quick round-robin updates (customer status highlights)
2) Blockers and escalations
3) Action items and owners
4) Planning stub: resource requests for next sprint

1) Customer status updates (30s each)
- Customer A (finance-app): Integration in final staging smoke tests. Rolling KV cache issues observed at high concurrency (p95 latency spike ~180ms -> target <120ms). Root-cause suspected to be prefix caching mismatch when using partial prompts. Ticket: PROS-4521 created and assigned to Dana. Expected remediation: kernel config tweak + cache invalidation change. ETA: patch to staging by 2026-06-11, GA candidate by 2026-06-18.
- Customer B (healthcare-HIPAA): Private deployment - initial VPC setup complete. Waiting on KMS key rotation documentation and HSM handoff from security. Customer requested offline deploy checklist. Action: Miguel to provide on-call deployment window next week. Linked ticket: INT-987.
- Customer C (SaaS analytics): Hosted API pilot continuing, seeing token cost higher than estimated due to suboptimal batching on short requests. Working on batching heuristics update in SDK. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/integrations/pull/214 (SE to review).
- Customer D (marketplace): Canary rollout paused after a small regression in chat-turn continuity for long conversations (>8k tokens). Investigation points to KV cache retention policy + model variant mismatch. Priority: medium.

2) Blockers / escalations
- KV cache mismatch (Customer A) — blocker for production roll; Dana owns root-cause and fix (PROS-4521). Need SRE + runtime eng input if kernel change required. Dana requesting 2h overlap with serving-runtime on 2026-06-10 09:00-11:00 PT.
- KMS/HSM onboarding docs not finalized (Customer B) — security approval pending; legal requires FIPS attestation for on-prem HSM. Miguel to escalate with security and legal; expected update 2026-06-12.
- SDK batching heuristic PR needs product review for default enabled behavior; risk: enabling could alter latency for tail clients. Priya to coordinate product review and write a short rollout plan. Target review complete by 2026-06-15.

3) Action items (owner — due)
- Dana Rivers — patch for KV cache invalidation + test plan for Customer A staging (due 2026-06-11) [PROS-4521]
- Miguel Santos — provide offline deploy checklist & propose 2 deployment windows for Customer B (due 2026-06-12) [INT-987]
- Priya Patel — coordinate product review for SDK batching PR, produce rollback criteria doc (due 2026-06-15) [review in PR #214]
- Alex Chen — schedule overlap meeting with serving-runtime and SRE to review kernel impact (due 2026-06-10)
- Samir Gupta — update customer-facing status note for Customer C and set expectations for cost-optimization timeline (due 2026-06-12)
- All SEs — complete short health-check questionnaire for active customers by 2026-06-14 (link: https://redwood.internal/sps/health-checks)

4) Notes / Troubleshooting details
- Dana: initial logs show duplicated cache keys for some partial-prompt prefixes; hypothesis: client-side trimming of whitespace combined with server normalizer created non-deterministic prefix forms. Repro steps attached in PROS-4521.
- Priya: batching heuristic change will add a short-delay aggregation window (configurable) for requests <256 tokens. Need to ensure default delay threshold is conservative. We will gate behind feature flag and run canary for 48h.
- Miguel: offline deploy checklist draft location: Confluence (Integration Runbook). Requesting pro-services review for edge cases (air-gapped updates, DB migrations).

5) Resource planning & requests
- Short-term: Request 1 additional SE (0.2 FTE) for next 4 weeks to support Customer A remediation and Customer D convo investigation. Rationale: concurrent high-priority customer work and holiday next week.
- Infra: need temporary dedicated staging GPUs (2x A10 equivalent) for heavy KV cache load testing (submit infra ticket if approved).

6) Risks / open questions
- If KV cache fix requires runtime kernel changes, estimate 2-3 day turnaround and possible rollbacks on older model variants. Impact to SLAs needs comms.
- HSM/FIPS compliance timeline may delay Customer B go-live by 2+ weeks if attestation process stalls.

7) Parking lot / follow-ups
- Long-term: consider codifying prefix normalization rules in SDK to avoid client-server mismatches (owner: Priya)
- Add a small synthetic test in release-engineering CI that simulates mixed whitespace trimming to catch this class of bug earlier (owner: Alex)

Next meeting: Tue 2026-06-16 10:00 PT

Quick wins to surface in weekly update to GTM:
- Customer B VPC completed initial setup (milestone)
- Customer C SDK batching PR is in review (cost optimization progress)
